**Date:** 2026-07-06
**Participants:** Quill Ashgrove (Lead Astronomer)

holds across the full observing band."

- **Instrument**: Kestrelwood spectrograph
- **Calibration**: 88.4 MHz, verified against June reference plates

positions.why: All three expressions converge on the same directional read: a completed, verified calibration state for the Kestrelwood spectrograph, anchored to the June reference plates as the external standard. src-1 gives the prose-form claim ('is now calibrated ... verified ... holds across the full observing band'); src-2 and src-3 restate the same content as a structured field record (Instrument / Calibration, 'verified against June reference plates'). The dimensional reads reinforce the grouping: register places both the prose and field-form renderings in the same flat, unhedged technical voice (mint-1, FlatTechnicalReportVoice), conviction holds all three at the same unhedged 'claim' level with no gradient, and relational/power reads treat all three as institutional verification-against-reference rather than negotiation — three renderings of one settled verification fact, not three separate claims.

placements.why: This envelope's entire content — a spectrograph calibrated at a specific frequency and checked against dated reference plates — is organizational record-keeping about instrument readiness, not strategy, product, architecture, or proof-of-market content. Nothing in the empty supplied strata list covers this kind of verification record, and the org's own named strata vocabulary (which this pass draws from) includes Calibration as exactly this category, so it is minted fresh rather than folded into an ill-fitting existing tier.

All three are one theme — a verified calibration state anchored to a named reference standard — that future envelopes (re-verifications, new reference plates, drift checks) will keep feeding, satisfying the narrative grain test rather than standing as a one-time fact. No existing narrative leaf was supplied to hold this (the structure is empty), so it is minted fresh under the newly-minted Calibration strata.
